Index Price: The price of the Tick Root.
Mark Price: This is the current mark price.

en_US.contract_flat_price_content: If the mark price of the contract reaches below this price (when long) or above this price (when short), your position will be liquidated.
en_US.contract_cost_content: The cost (in margin) to execute this order. This includes your selected leverage and your current position, if any. Reducing a position does not cost margin.
en_US.contract_price_tag_content: The latest mark price for this contract. This is the price used for PNL and margin calculations, and may differ from the last price for the purposes of avoiding price manipulation. This does not affect settlement.
en_US.contract_margin_content: The amount of margin locked by each position. If you have isolated margin on a position, this number will go down as the margin remaining decreases, and your effective leverage rises. Drag the leverage slider in the sidebar to adjust the margin assigned to your position.
en_US.contract_market_content: Click to close your entire XBTUSD position at market.
en_US.contract_price_content:
Index Price: The price of the Tick Root.
Mark Price: This is the current mark price.
This indicator shows your position in the auto-deleverage queue. If all lights are lit, in the event of a liquidation, your position may be reduced.
en_US.contract_order_margin_content: Order Margin: The minimum equity you must retain with the exchange to keep your open orders. This is the value of all open orders you have divided by the selected leverage.
en_US.contract_position_margin_content: Position Margin: The minimum equity you must retain with the exchange to keep your positions. This is the entry value of all contracts you hold divided by the selected leverage, plus unrealised profit and loss.
en_US.contract_unrealised_pnl_content: Unrealised PNL: Current profit and loss from all open positions.
en_US.contract_available_balance_content: Your margin available for new positions. Available Balance = (Margin Balance - Order Margin - Position Margin).

1. '3L' implies the increase in price of the underlying pair by 1% and the net value of the product has increased by 3%. 
 2.'3S' implies the decrease in price of the underlying pair by 1% and the net value of the product fell by 3% 
 3. Typically, the net value is adjusted at 0’oclock every day. The extreme market will be adjusted in the intraday.
 4.Every leverage will charge the corresponding management fee on a daily basis. 
 5. Please pay attention to the net value of the asset before trading. There is a risk of the price approaching zero in extreme conditions. Therefore, make sure to understand the risks involved.
en_US.etf_text_networthPrompt:
Net Value For Long = Net value at the last adjustment point * [1+ 3 * (Latest spot transaction price-spot last adjustment point price) / spot last adjustment point price * 100%]；

Net Value For Short = Net value at the last adjustment point * [1- 3 * (Latest spot transaction price-spot last adjustment point price) / spot last adjustment point price * 100%]；

Please be cautious when trading at a price that deviates significantly from the net value

en_US.sl_str_risk_disclosure_notice:
1. When you trade in the contract market, if the market declines, your position margin will be insufficient. Please keep in mind that the exchange Swap will place a mandatory liquidation order and send you liquidation details according to the system agreement. 
2. Please read carefully and follow the business rules of the exchange Swap. Understand the contract mechanism and operation principle, understand the various risks of the market, and reasonably arrange funds for trading. 
3. Under certain extreme market conditions, it may be difficult or impossible to close out your open positions. For example, when your profit ranks first in the effective contract PnL in the entire contract market, and the insurance fund is insufficient to cover the losses. 
4. In case of changes in local laws, regulations and policies, amendments to bourse trading rules, and introduction of emergency measures, the exchange will notice you in advance that you may not maintain open positions, but the position margin and profitable balance will still be paid! 
5. For any reasons beyond the control of the exchange, such as earthquakes, floods, fire and other factors or computer system and communication system failures, etc., your order may not be executed in part or in whole, and you may suffer losses therefrom. 
6. Like speculative transactions,"hedging" transactions also face the risks caused by price fluctuations. Please understand the relevant mechanism in advance. 
7. If you lend your account to a third party, the safety of your contract deposit may be affected. Please carefully protect your personal account.

en_US.etf_notes_manual_lever_tran_info: Through daily position adjst., the system makes profit increase and loss reduction of contract leverage positions in the bottom levels of ETF. This ensures that the user's ETF leverage ratio is consistent with the agreed ratio.ETF is divided into two kinds: timed position adjst. and no timed position adjst., in which timed position adjst. refers that the platform will at the daily fixed time point execute position rebalancing management, used to ensure that ETFs are in the agreed multiple leverage at the beginning of the day;A no timed position adjst. refers to a temporary position adjst. when the actual leverage multiple of an ETF exceeds a certain level within a day, and the position is the agreed multiple leverage after the position adjst.

en_US.etf_question_anwsersa: If the price of BTC increases by 1%, the net value of the leverage ETF will rise by about 3% // if the price of BTC decreases by 1%, the net value of the leverage ETF will fall by about 3%

en_US.etf_question_anwsersc: In a unilateral market, leverage ETFs may have compound interest gains // leverage ETFs are suitable for both long-term and short-term holdings, in volatile markets, the net value of leverage ETFs may be worn out
en_US.etf_question_anwserse: Timed position adjustment: Daily fixed time point to adjust the leverage multiple to the target multiple, to ensure that the net value of daily tracking spot of a certain multiple // timed position adjustment: daily fixed time point to adjust the leverage multiple to the target multiple, to ensure that the net value of daily tracking spot of a certain multiple // floating leverage adjustment position: when leverage ETF's actual leverage multiple exceeds the set floating leverage range to adjust the position
